correctness.rationale: The genus is 3 by the 4+1 total ramification of the degree-3 superelliptic cover. In characteristic 5 with basis dx/y², x dx/y², dx/y, the semilinear Cartier map sends the first to the third, second to zero, and third to [x⁴]f³^(1/5) first + [x⁹]f³^(1/5) second, with [x⁴]f³=3(c²+a²c+ab²) and [x⁹]f³=3b. On the separable locus these two coefficients are not simultaneously zero, so Cartier rank is exactly 2 (a-number1); stable rank is 0 for P=0 and 2 for P≠0, excluding p-ranks 1 and 3. Independent symbolic discriminant computation modulo5 verified D=a⁴c+a³b²+2a²c²−ab²c−2b⁴+c³, and polynomial reduction gave a²D=−2c³(a²+c) modulo P. On P=0 smoothness is equivalent to b≠0. The partial derivatives (2ac+b²,2ab,2c+a²) make the hypersurface smooth there. As monic quadratic in c its discriminant a(a³+b²) has odd a-valuation, proving absolute irreducibility. For a=0 the smooth zero-rank locus is b∈G_m,c=0; for a≠0, t=b/a and s=c/a² give a=−t²/[s(s+1)], s∉{0,−1}, t≠0, with valid regular inverse charts. Thus [V]=[G_m]+[G_m]([A¹]−2)=[G_m]² and #V(F_q)=(q−1)² for every q=5^n. Translation by quartic cubic coefficient (invertible 4 in char5) gives #U(F_q)=(q⁴−q³)/q=q³−q², and complementary count (q−1)(q²−q+1). Independent polynomial-GCD enumeration over F_5 and F_25 confirmed (100,16,84) and (15000,576,14424), and a separate symbolic script verified [x⁴]f³ and [x⁹]f³. These finite checks corroborate but do not establish all-n proofs.

value.rationale: The fixed monic centered smooth quartic family is a canonical three-dimensional parameter space for genus-three Picard curves; p-rank is a natural isogeny invariant. An entire rank-zero divisor is classified as smooth irreducible, with explicit charts, motivic class (L−1)² and exact marked F_{5^n} counts for every extension. Those are structurally useful finite-field moduli facts and not a routine isolated tabulation. The result explicitly distinguishes marked coefficients from curve isomorphism classes, and does not pretend to classify Newton polygons.
residual_risks: The object is a marked coefficient family, not a moduli-space isomorphism-class census.
The title phrase nonordinary divisor is imprecise because every smooth family member has a-number1; the mathematical statement precisely defines V as the zero-p-rank locus.
